# FNB-ETAF API and UI performance guidance

- Keep protocol/API performance and UI performance separate. API performance uses the performance module and JMeter DSL. UI performance uses isolated concurrent real-browser virtual users in ui_performance.
- Do not merge ui_performance into normal Hooks, standard UI runners, standard browser lifecycle, or Extent/PDF Cucumber reporting. Its isolation is intentional.
- UI performance concurrency belongs to UiPerformanceEngine and its synchronized start gate, not TestNG/Cucumber scenario parallelism.
- Keep user count, ramp stages, hold duration, headless mode, safety caps, thresholds, target details, and report formats configurable in the dedicated YAML resources.
- Respect configured safety limits and approved targets. Never escalate load automatically or create an unbounded virtual-user default.
- Preserve response-status validation, error thresholds, readable timing, sensitive-text sanitization, and shareable report accuracy.
